title: diplotaxis humilis
intro: Diplotaxis humilis, commonly known as Wild Rocket or Land Cress, is a species of plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Diplotaxis humilis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of Diplotaxis humilis include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
